name: weave_run_tool
description: Runs a Weave tool (a published Weave workflow) and returns run ids; poll them with weave_get_tool_run_output. A pasted Weave URL (app.weavy.ai/tool/<id> or app.weavy.ai/flow/<id>) is enough — never open a browser or use browser automation for Weave. Call weave_get_tool_inputs first to learn the inputs. This tool spends the user's Weave credits, so it is gated: it returns `status: "inputs_required"` or `cost_confirmation_required` with instructions to follow. Always show the user the cost and get an explicit Approve/Cancel (a structured prompt, not free text) before echoing `acknowledgedCost` to run — every run, including reruns — and confirm any auto-filled inputs (values you did not set that the run will use). Include the response's `costDisclosure` string as its own sentence after the question, not folded into it, the first time you quote a cost in a conversation; omit it after that. For an image/video input, pass a reachable https URL directly; only upload a local file with weave_upload_asset and pass the asset object it returns. If the user wants an input you did not get from weave_get_tool_inputs, do not omit it or fold it into another input like the prompt — re-fetch weave_get_tool_inputs (its inputs can change) and set it.

recipeId.description: The id of the Weave tool to run — from weave_list_tools, or the `<id>` in a pasted Weave URL (app.weavy.ai/tool/<id> or app.weavy.ai/flow/<id>), which is the recipeId.

version.description: The tool `version` from weave_get_tool_inputs; omit to run the latest.

inputs.description: Values for the inputs you want to set. Omit an input to keep its current value.

value.description: The value for this input, in the shape for its `type` (from weave_get_tool_inputs): text→string, integer→number, boolean→true/false, select→one of its `options`, seed→a number (or omit this input for random), image/video→a reachable https URL, color→a hex string like "#RRGGBB" (or a list of them), an iterator→an array of values (runs once per item).

numberOfRuns.description: How many times to run the tool (1–10).

acknowledgedCost.description: The credit `cost` the tool quoted in its `cost_confirmation_required` response, echoed back after the user approves to confirm the spend and run. For a dynamic-cost tool (the response had `isDynamicCost: true` and `cost: null`), pass `-1` to confirm a variable charge.
